# Code Review

Review the diff, not assumptions. Check phase scope, ownership/RLS, secret handling, error paths, cancellation, persistence, provider costs, accessibility, tests, and documentation. Report only actionable findings with file/line, impact, confidence, and suggested fix; distinguish defects from follow-up improvements.
